messages.content: I reviewed the Bay Street confirmation, and the destination charge makes me want to compare it once more with the Forsyth option. Can you put both on the same basis for June 20 through 23? We will not have a car, so leave parking out.

Yes. For one room and two adults over three nights, Bay Street House is $864.58 including room charges, taxes, and its mandatory destination charge. Forsyth Park Inn is $869.76 including room charges and taxes, with no mandatory property fee listed. Valet parking is optional at both and is excluded from these totals.
So Forsyth is only $5.18 more? The earlier comparison made the riverfront hotel sound less expensive before all the charges.

Correct. The base room rate at Bay Street House is lower, but its nightly destination charge reduces nearly all of that advantage. On the final amount payable, Forsyth Park Inn costs $5.18 more for the full stay.
Compare the trips to the Saturday ceremony and Sunday brunch. The ceremony is at 4:00 near Forsyth Park, and brunch is at 11:00 on the riverfront.

From Forsyth Park Inn, the ceremony is about a 5- to 10-minute walk, while the riverfront brunch is roughly a 25-minute walk or a 10-minute rideshare. From Bay Street House, Sunday brunch is about a 5-minute walk, while the ceremony is around a 20- to 25-minute walk or a short rideshare. Forsyth is more convenient for the time-sensitive ceremony; Bay Street is more convenient for brunch.
Please check the payment and cancellation language closely. I could not tell when Bay Street actually charges the card.

Forsyth Park Inn requires a card guarantee but no advance payment. The full amount is due at check-in, and cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time on June 18; after that, the penalty is one night's room and tax. Bay Street House says the card may be charged for one night any time after booking, with the balance due at check-in. Cancellation is free through June 17, but the confirmation does not state what time that deadline expires. After the deadline, the listed penalty is the one-night deposit.
And both will hold two suitcases after the 11:00 checkout Monday? Our flight is not until 1:35.

Yes. Both front desks confirm complimentary luggage storage for registered guests after the 11:00 a.m. checkout. For the 1:35 p.m. SAV departure, you should retrieve the bags and leave the hotel at about 11:40 a.m.; that timing works from either property.
The small price difference is not enough to outweigh the easier ceremony trip and clearer terms. Is the Forsyth king still available for two adults?

It is. One king room remains available for June 20-23 at the verified total of $869.76. The rate is refundable under the June 18 at 6:00 p.m. cancellation deadline, and no payment is due before check-in.
Switch us to that. Reserve the Forsyth king, make sure the bag-storage note is attached, and cancel Bay Street only after the new room is confirmed.

The Forsyth Park Inn king room is confirmed first for two adults, June 20-23, at $869.76 total. Confirmation: FPI-6209446. No advance charge is due; cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time on June 18, after which the penalty is one night's room and tax. The reservation notes Monday storage for two suitcases after the 11:00 a.m. checkout.

Bay Street House has then been canceled with no penalty, and its $864.58 reservation is no longer active. Your flights remain unchanged under D7K4QP: Friday departing Denver at 8:20 a.m. and arriving Savannah at 2:18 p.m. via Atlanta, then Monday departing Savannah at 1:35 p.m. and arriving Denver at 5:58 p.m. The Saturday 4:00 p.m. ceremony and Sunday 11:00 a.m. brunch are unchanged.
